subject: post-cm17-continuum-kinematic-model
review_scope: Read full postulate, exact body/motion/material-region/spatial-calculus/frame/worldline suppliers and repaired remark; checked direct uses of the postulate. Indirect consumers are a dependency inventory, not a fresh substantive audit.
reasoning: The universal implication C2 motion and positive Jacobian imply no material interface is false, but that implication is not asserted by the actual postulate.

The opening says Adopt as physical assumptions ... following statements. Clause(iv) explicitly says excluded by this postulate, and no statement of this page covers them. Clause(vi) says adopted assumptions, not derived from mechanics. These jointly specify model membership; the regularity parenthesis truthfully states clause(ii) and contains no causal or deductive connective.

The repaired remark explicitly identifies material-interface exclusion as a separately adopted scope restriction, not a consequence of smoothness, and notes that motion/fields may extend smoothly across an interface.

The direct consumer uses inspected adopt the model or invoke its motion/domain/velocity regularity; no inspected use invokes regularity as a proof that interfaces cannot exist. No proof, hypothesis or public scope needs narrowing or repair.

counterexample.scope: Counterexample only to the alleged regularity implication, not to the full postulate which separately excludes the interface.
counterexample.body: In one fixed inertial frame let B=(-1,1)^3, O=(-2,2)^3, I=(-1,1); B is nonempty bounded open, closure(B) is contained in O, and I is a nonempty open time interval.
counterexample.motion: chi(t,X)=X is C-infinity; each chi_t is injective with D_X chi_t=I_3 and J=1>0. Omega_t=B, u=0 and material acceleration a=0. The worldline gamma_X(t)=(t,X) is C-infinity and has the frame-time parameter t.
counterexample.interface: Mark B-minus={X in B:X1<0} and B-plus={X in B:X1>0} as two material portions, separated by S={X in B:X1=0}. S is a stationary smooth material interface carried by the identity motion.
counterexample.fields: Choose a constant positive density and zero stress/pressure/body force, all C-infinity across S; no required field regularity is violated. The additional material partition is not forbidden by the mathematical body/motion predicates. It is forbidden only when the full physical postulate including clause(iv) is adopted.

recommendation: Resolve the alleged mathematical implication as unasserted; retain the exact existing source and adopted interface exclusion. No mandatory clarification patch is proposed. A future optional editorial clarification would be an explicit source-interface change requiring native ownership and consumer handling, not a silent repair.
